$schema: Data-driven deny list for invented fields the model tends to send. Keyed by tool name (matches operation manifest tool names). Each forbidden field has a 'reason' explaining why it is rejected and a 'canonical' field name to point the model at the correct shape.

paymentBrand.reason: create_merchant_account does not accept paymentBrand. Payment brands are attached later via attach_merchant_account.

paymentBrands.reason: create_merchant_account does not accept paymentBrands. Payment brands are attached later via attach_merchant_account.

brands.reason: create_merchant_account does not accept brands. Payment brands are attached later via attach_merchant_account.

config.reason: create_merchant_account does not accept a config object. Settings are managed via settings.edit after create.
